WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND d_year IN (2000, 2000+1, 2000+2)
),
filtered_hd AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND CASE WHEN hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN hd_dep_count / hd_vehicle_count END > 1
),
dj AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, count(*) AS cnt
    FROM filtered_date_dim dd
    JOIN store_sales ON dd.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_hd hd ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    WHERE store.s_county IN ('Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County')
    GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk
    HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
)
SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, ss_ticket_number, cnt
FROM customer
JOIN dj ON dj.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY cnt DESC, c_last_name ASC
